model_type: Strategic allocation planning range — research-only framework, no point return forecast

active_base_core.role: Evidence-preserving inactive fallback while account, contract, data, risk-budget and jurisdiction gates are unresolved.

direct_equities.current_model_treatment: open item-level admission only; no current direct-equity model exposure
required_independent_review: dated public filings and accounting availability
valuation and target-price evidence if T3 issuer is named
approved risk budget, loss limit and independent challenge

public_reits.inactive_behavior: remain in protected liquidity until project-specific dossier is complete
required_checks: named vehicle and independently researched underlying project
tax, suitability, approved risk budget and independent review
dated contract lifecycle, roll and delivery evidence
margin, price-limit, position-limit and forced-close treatment
next-session fill, costs, slippage and unavailable-exit replay
approved risk budget, daily loss limit and independent review

crypto_assets_or_products.current_model_treatment: economic research only; China-mainland implementation not approved
required_independent_review: venue, counterparty, custody and recovery rights
independent price/mark source and data retention
token/protocol, governance and smart-contract risks where relevant
no leverage, funding, lending, staking or rehypothecation shortcut
approved risk budget and loss limit

cash_distribution_policy.current_treatment: No cash-yield objective is set. Protected liquidity is an inactive evidence boundary, not a forecasted income sleeve.

eligible_receipt_types: realised trading proceeds net of documented costs
not_receipt_types: margin released but not realised return
cash_ledger_and_accounting.capital_repayment_like_component: Return of capital, principal repayment or similar cash movement is recorded separately from income and not automatically classified as investment return.

total_return_measurement.formula: For a future approved paper or live study, total return = change in marked portfolio value plus eligible cash receipts minus documented fees, taxes, financing and trading costs, with external flows excluded from TWRR periods.
total_return_measurement.reinvestment_rule: Cash is recorded on its actual receipt date; any later reinvestment is a separately dated flow and is not assumed automatically.
total_return_measurement.cash_receipt_accounting_rule: Each eligible cash receipt is recognised once in the cash ledger and once only in total-return reconciliation; it must not also be embedded in a duplicated price-return series.

return_evidence.formal_test_requirement: Run a point-in-time, roll-aware, costed paper replay with declared data availability, execution timing, outages, price-limit/halts, margin and failed-exit scenarios before a separate review.
return_evidence.benchmark_requirement: Compare every candidate sleeve with a clearly defined no-action and relevant passive or cash benchmark; report distribution of outcomes rather than a target return.

risk_budget.approval_requirement: A personal risk-capital statement, account/product permissions, tax context, liquidity needs and independent challenge must be documented before any allocation decision.
risk_budget.loss_limit: No loss limit has been approved. A future limit must state NAV basis, daily/weekly and drawdown controls, margin-call response and a freeze/escalation owner.

crypto_legal_blocker.policy: No China-mainland crypto implementation route or workaround is provided.
